mcq-g1.question: What does the Italian phrase “Come stai?” mean?
mcq-g1.explanation: “Come stai?” is used to informally ask “How are you?” to one person.

mcq-art1.question: Which masculine definite article is used with the word “ragazzo”?
mcq-art1.explanation: Nouns starting with standard consonants take “il” in the masculine singular.

mcq-verb1.question: Choose the correct form of “essere” for “noi” (we):
mcq-verb1.explanation: Conjugation of essere: io sono, tu sei, lui/lei è, noi siamo, voi siete, loro sono.

mcq-dir1.question: What does “Dov'è la stazione?” mean?
mcq-dir1.explanation: “Dov'è...” is a contraction of “Dove è...” meaning “Where is...?”.

options.text: A) When does the train arrive?
B) Where is the train station?
C) How much is the ticket?

blk-g1.question: “___, come stai?”
blk-g1.explanation: “Ciao” goes at the start of an informal greeting.

blk-v1.question: “Io ___ studente di italiano.”
blk-v1.explanation: First person singular of essere: “Io sono”.
blk-v1.hint: Hint: form of essere for “I am”

blk-art1.question: “___ casa è grande e luminosa.”
blk-art1.explanation: Casa is feminine singular, so the article is “la”.

reorder-g1.explanation: Word order for greeting: Ciao, come stai?

listen-g1.instruction: Listen to the audio and pick the translation

dlg-g1.explanation: To answer “Come ti chiami?”, start with “Mi chiamo...”.
dlg-g1.instruction: B: choose the line that continues the introduction

mcq-greeting-evening.question: Which polite greeting do you use in the evening?
mcq-greeting-evening.explanation: Buonasera is a polite greeting used in the evening.

blank-greeting-daytime.question: Greet someone politely during the day: “_____!”
blank-greeting-daytime.explanation: Buongiorno is a polite daytime greeting.

mcq-name-question.question: How do you ask “What is your name?” in Italian?
mcq-name-question.explanation: Come ti chiami? asks someone’s name.

blank-name-answer.question: Complete the phrase: “Mi _____ Luca.”
blank-name-answer.explanation: Mi chiamo Luca means “My name is Luca.”
blank-name-answer.hint: This is how you say “My name is...” in Italian.

mcq-shop1.question: How do you ask for the price of an item in Italian?
mcq-shop1.explanation: “Quanto costa?” is used to ask the price of a single item.

options.text: Un cappuccino e una brioche, per favore.

dlg-cafe1.explanation: When asked “Cosa desidera?”, specify what you want to order.
dlg-cafe1.instruction: B: choose the line to order at the cafe bar
